roadmap.title: First runs
roadmap.description: Complete your first Teleporter events, learn the basics and rack up early deaths and totals.

roadmap.title: Learning the run
roadmap.description: Clear single-run goals: shrines, items, logs, drones and the first few stages.

roadmap.title: Unlock survivors
roadmap.description: Unlock new survivors and finish their early challenges.

roadmap.title: Full clears
roadmap.description: Beat the game, loop, win on Monsoon and earn each survivor's Mastery.

roadmap.title: Artifact trials and special stages
roadmap.description: Complete the Trials to unlock Artifacts and finish special stages and modes.

roadmap.title: Hard survivor challenges
roadmap.description: Pull off build-, skill- and speed-specific survivor goals.

roadmap.title: Endgame extremes
roadmap.description: Finish the rarest challenges: Soulbound Threshold, Hexes and the late Prime Meridian goals.

achievements.description: Reach +200% attack speed.
achievements.summary: Reach +200% attack speed.

steps.text: Collect @item{Soldier's Syringe} items. Each one adds 15% attack speed, so 14 reach +200%.
steps.note: A 3D Printer that prints this item, or Artifact of Command, makes it quicker.

steps.text: Add a @item{War Horn} activation or other frenzy buff items to fill any gap.

achievements.description: Activate 6 turrets in a single run.
achievements.summary: Activate 6 Gunner Turrets in a single run.

steps.text: Buy every Gunner Turret you find until you have activated 6 in the run.
steps.note: They can be spread across stages, and earlier ones may die.

achievements.description: Stabilize the Cell in the Void Fields.
achievements.summary: Finish all 9 cell events in the Void Fields hidden realm.

steps.text: Find a @mechanic{Newt Altar} on a stage, pay 1 Lunar coin, and finish the Teleporter event.
Enter the Blue Portal to the Bazaar Between Time, then jump off the platform down into the cave and follow it to the Null Portal.
Complete the 9 cell events in the Void Fields, one after another.
steps.note: Stay inside the cell radius or it stops charging and you take damage. Artifact of Kin limits the monsters to one type.

achievements.description: Die three times while burning.
achievements.summary: Die three times while burning.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Blazing elites} so they set you on fire.
steps.note: Artifact of Honor or Combat Shrines make elites more common.

steps.text: Die while the burn debuff is still on you. Do this three times.
steps.note: The attack that kills you must be different from the attack that lit you.

achievements.description: As Captain, repair and recruit a TC-280 Prototype.
achievements.summary: Playing Captain, fix and recruit the giant TC-280 Prototype drone.

steps.text: Reach Rallypoint Delta and save up gold.
Find the TC-280 Prototype and buy it.

achievements.description: As Captain, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Finish a Monsoon run playing Captain, either by winning the final fight or by obliterating.

steps.text: Unlock Captain by beating the game.
Start a run as Captain on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run by beating the final boss on Commencement, or by obliterating at the Obelisk after the Celestial Portal.

achievements.description: As Captain, visit 10 different environments in a single run.
achievements.summary: Playing Captain, enter 10 distinct environments within one run.

steps.text: Visit hidden realms such as the Bazaar Between Time, Void Fields, Gilded Coast and Bulwark's Ambry.
Loop to reach other stage environments until you have been to 10.

achievements.description: Carry 5 Lunar items in a single run.
achievements.summary: Carry 5 Lunar items at the same time in a single run.

steps.text: Save Lunar coins, then activate a @mechanic{Newt Altar} to open the Blue Portal to the Bazaar Between Time.
steps.note: Lunar coins drop from monsters or come from a run's end.

steps.text: Buy Lunar items in the Bazaar (2 coins each) or open Lunar Pods until you hold 5.
steps.note: Lunar equipment counts toward the 5.

achievements.description: Charge the Teleporter with less than 10% health.
achievements.summary: Fully charge a Teleporter while below 10% health.

steps.text: Charge the Teleporter to 99% and kill everything nearby.
Step out of the radius and take damage, such as a fall off the map, until your health is under 10%.
Step back into the radius to finish the charge.

achievements.description: Destroy 20 flying rocks in Sky Meadow.
achievements.summary: Break 20 of the rocks flying across the Sky Meadow map.

steps.text: Reach stage 5, which is always @loc{Sky Meadow}.
Stand near the center of the map and shoot or hit the passing rocks until 20 have broken.
steps.note: The @item{Royal Capacitor} equipment helps.

achievements.description: As Commando, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: On Monsoon, use Commando to win the run by killing the final boss or by obliterating at the Obelisk.

steps.text: Select Commando and start a run on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run either by defeating the final boss on @loc{Commencement} or by obliterating at the Obelisk.
steps.note: Take Sky Meadow's Teleporter while it faces the moon for Commencement. The Celestial Portal to the Obelisk appears after the stage 8 Teleporter event.

achievements.description: As Commando, fully charge the first-stage teleporter before the timer hits 5 minutes.
achievements.summary: Use Commando to fully charge stage 1's Teleporter in under 5 minutes.

steps.text: Select Commando and, on stage 1, find the Teleporter at once and start the event.
steps.note: Floating particles surround the Teleporter.

steps.text: Kill the boss and stay in the radius until the charge reaches 100% before 5:00.
steps.note: Drizzle makes this easier.

achievements.description: As Commando, land the killing blow on an Overloading Worm.
achievements.summary: Use Commando to deliver the final blow to an Overloading Worm.

steps.text: Play Commando on @loc{Sky Meadow}, where an Overloading Worm can spawn as the Teleporter boss.
steps.note: Shrines of the Mountain can also bring it.

steps.text: Land the killing blow on the Overloading Worm yourself.
steps.note: It shows blue lightning when it surfaces.

achievements.description: As Commando, clear 20 stages in a single run without picking up any Lunar items.
achievements.summary: Use Commando to clear 20 stages in one run while picking up no Lunar items.

steps.text: Select Commando and start a run; never pick up a Lunar item from a Lunar Pod or the Bazaar.
steps.note: Entering the Bazaar and spending Lunar Coins on non-item things is fine.

steps.text: Clear 20 stages in this run; hidden realms do not count.
steps.note: Looping from Sky Meadow keeps the count rising.

achievements.description: Complete 20 stages in a single run.
achievements.summary: Finish 20 stages within one run.

steps.text: Beat each stage's Teleporter event and keep going past stage 5 by looping.
steps.note: Use the Primordial Teleporter's spikes or a Lunar portal on stage 5 to loop back to stage 1.

steps.text: Keep the run alive until your 20th stage is completed.
steps.note: Drizzle and Artifact of Command make a strong build easier to reach.

achievements.description: Complete 30 stages.
achievements.summary: Complete 30 stages in total across all runs.

steps.text: Keep playing runs; each stage you complete adds 1 to the total.
steps.note: To go faster, repeat stage 1 and leave through the Teleporter each time.

achievements.description: Beat the game.
achievements.summary: Beat the game by defeating the final boss at Commencement.

steps.text: On stage 5, activate the @mechanic{Primordial Teleporter} but leave its outer spikes alone.
steps.note: Touching the spikes sends you back to stage 1 for a loop.

steps.text: At Commencement, defeat the final boss and reach the ship.
steps.note: Drizzle is the easiest difficulty.

achievements.description: Beat the game on Monsoon difficulty.
achievements.summary: Beat the game by defeating the final boss on Monsoon difficulty.

steps.text: Start a run on Monsoon.
Build damage, activate the Primordial Teleporter on stage 5, and defeat the final boss at Commencement.
steps.note: Learn the boss phases; Artifact of Command is a strong aid but makes the last phase risky.

achievements.description: Defeat the Teleporter bosses after activating 2 Shrines of the Mountain.
achievements.summary: Beat the Teleporter bosses on a stage where 2 Shrines of the Mountain are active.

steps.text: Find and activate 2 @mechanic{Shrines of the Mountain} on a stage before starting the Teleporter.
Start the Teleporter and defeat all the bosses that appear.
steps.note: Extra shrines can make the boss an elite, so be careful.

achievements.description: Complete a Prismatic Trial.
achievements.summary: Complete a Prismatic Trial.

steps.text: Select Prismatic Trials from the main menu and start the current trial.
Finish the trial's Teleporter event to complete it.
steps.note: Failed attempts can be retried while the trial lasts.

achievements.description: Complete a Teleporter event.
achievements.summary: Complete a Teleporter event.

steps.text: Find the Teleporter on stage 1; floating particles surround it.
Activate it, defeat the boss, and charge it to 100% from inside its radius.

achievements.description: Fully charge a Teleporter without getting hit.
achievements.summary: Fully charge a Teleporter without taking any hit.

steps.text: Charge the Teleporter while dodging every attack.
steps.note: Kill enemies as they spawn using Ceremonial Daggers and damage items, or move constantly.

achievements.description: Reach and complete the 3rd Teleporter event without dying.
achievements.summary: Finish the 3rd Teleporter event of a run without having died.

steps.text: Complete the Teleporter events on stages 1, 2, and 3 without dying.
steps.note: Reaching stage 4 alive counts. Drizzle makes it easier.

achievements.description: Without healing, reach and complete the 3rd Teleporter event.
achievements.summary: Finish the 3rd Teleporter event of a run having never healed.

steps.text: Avoid every healing item, healing drone, healing equipment, and healing skill.
steps.note: Passive regeneration and shield recharge are fine.

steps.text: Complete the Teleporter events on stages 1, 2, and 3.
steps.note: Topaz Brooches give barrier and are a safe aid.

achievements.description: Obliterate yourself at the Obelisk..
achievements.summary: Obliterate yourself by activating the Obelisk in the Celestial Portal realm.

steps.text: Loop the game once and reach stage 8.
steps.note: To loop, touch the Primordial Teleporter's spikes on stage 5.

steps.text: Complete that stage's Teleporter event and enter the @loc{Celestial Portal}.
Walk to the giant Obelisk and activate it.
steps.note: Drizzle with Artifact of Command makes the trip easier.

achievements.description: As Acrid, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Finish a Monsoon run playing Acrid, either by winning the final fight or by obliterating.

steps.text: Unlock Acrid by stabilizing the Cell in the Void Fields.
Start a run as Acrid on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run by beating the final boss on Commencement, or by obliterating at the Obelisk after the Celestial Portal.

achievements.description: As Acrid, land the final blow on a Scavenger.
achievements.summary: Playing Acrid, deliver the killing hit to a Scavenger.

steps.text: Loop the game at least once.
Find a Scavenger and poison it, then land the last hit yourself.

achievements.description: As Acrid, land the killing blow on 50 total enemies that have 1 hit point left.
achievements.summary: Playing Acrid, finish off 50 enemies in total while each is at exactly 1 health.

steps.text: Poison enemies with Acrid and let the poison bring them to 1 health.
Land the killing blow on each; repeat until you have 50 total.

achievements.description: As Acrid, inflict Poison 1000 total times.
achievements.summary: Playing Acrid, apply Poison to enemies a combined 1000 times.

steps.text: Use Acrid's skills so poison spreads to many enemies, and keep playing until you reach 1,000 applications.

achievements.description: Defeat the unique guardian of Siren's Call.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Alloy Worship Unit on Siren's Call.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Siren's Call}, which is one of the two stage 4 maps.
Destroy the 5 Alloy Vulture nests scattered over the map to summon the @enemy{Alloy Worship Unit}.
Defeat the Alloy Worship Unit.
steps.note: It has a lot of health; avoid its large circles while it shields.

achievements.description: Die 5 times.
achievements.summary: Die 5 times.

steps.text: Die in runs until your death count reaches 5.
steps.note: A quick method is to take damage, jump off the map, and let a monster hit you.

achievements.description: Die 20 times.
achievements.summary: Die 20 times.

steps.text: Die in runs until your death count reaches 20.
steps.note: Deaths from Learning Process count toward this.

achievements.description: Pick up 5 different types of Equipment.
achievements.summary: Pick up 5 different Equipment.

steps.text: Pick up equipment from chests and shops until you have found 5 different kinds.
steps.note: Equipment Triple Shops on Scorched Acres and Sky Meadow help. The Logbook shows what you have found.

achievements.description: Discover 10 unique white items.
achievements.summary: Discover 10 different white (common) items.

steps.text: Pick up common items until the Logbook shows 10 different white items.
steps.note: Small chests, Multishop Terminals, and 3D Printers are good sources.

achievements.description: As Engineer, recruit 12 minions at one time.
achievements.summary: Use Engineer to have 12 minions under your control simultaneously.

steps.text: Select Engineer and repair every drone and turret you find, keeping them alive.
steps.note: Minions are the entries listed at the left of the HUD.

steps.text: With 3 Fuel Cells and the equipment @item{The Back-up}, use it 3 times to spawn 12 Strike Drones.
steps.note: Happiest Mask and Queen's Gland also add minions.

achievements.description: As Engineer, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: On Monsoon, use Engineer to win the run by killing the final boss or by obliterating at the Obelisk.

steps.text: Select Engineer and start a run on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run either by defeating the final boss on @loc{Commencement} or by obliterating at the Obelisk.
steps.note: Take Sky Meadow's Teleporter while it faces the moon for Commencement. The Celestial Portal to the Obelisk appears after the stage 8 Teleporter event.

achievements.description: As Engineer, finish charging the teleporter with zero monsters remaining on the stage.
achievements.summary: Use Engineer to finish Teleporter charging when no monsters at all are left on the stage.

steps.text: Select Engineer, start a Teleporter event and charge it to 99% while leaving the Teleporter boss alive.
steps.note: While the boss lives, more monsters stop spawning.

steps.text: Kill every other monster on the stage, then kill the boss and finish the charge.
steps.note: Ceremonial Daggers and damage items kill weak monsters fast.

achievements.description: As Engineer, defeat the teleporter boss in less than 5 seconds after it spawns.
achievements.summary: Use Engineer to kill the Teleporter boss in under 5 seconds after it appears.

steps.text: Select Engineer and start a Teleporter event, ideally where only one boss spawns.
steps.note: Looping makes this easier.

steps.text: Kill the boss within 5 seconds of its spawn with burst damage.
steps.note: Artifact of Glass, Preon Accumulator, Royal Capacitor or Sawmerang give burst damage.

achievements.description: Fail the Shrine of Chance 3 times in a row.
achievements.summary: Get a failed result from a Shrine of Chance three times consecutively.

steps.text: Find a @mechanic{Shrine of Chance} and keep interacting with it until it fails 3 times in a row.
steps.note: Bring plenty of gold; the cost rises each use.

achievements.description: Find the Altar to N'kuhana.
achievements.summary: Find the Altar to N'kuhana on Wetland Aspect.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Wetland Aspect}, one of the two stage 2 maps.
Go to the cliff edge, drop through the gap, and follow the path to the altar.
Destroy the skeleton at the altar.

achievements.description: Open the Timed Security Chest on Rallypoint Delta.
achievements.summary: On Rallypoint Delta, open the Timed Security Chest before the run clock hits 10:00.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Rallypoint Delta} (stage 3) before the run timer reaches 10:00.
steps.note: Do not spend too much time collecting items on the earlier stages.

steps.text: Find the Timed Security Chest, marked by two red lamps, and open it.
steps.note: It can be in containers near the middle of the map or on the hill.

achievements.description: Discover and activate 8 unique Newt Altars.
achievements.summary: Discover and activate 8 different Newt Altars.

steps.text: Search each stage for a @mechanic{Newt Altar} and pay 1 Lunar coin to activate it.
steps.note: Every altar location is different, so they can be on the same stage in different spots.

steps.text: Repeat until 8 different altars are activated.
steps.note: Mobility items help reach hidden spots.

achievements.description: Free the survivor suspended in time.
achievements.summary: Free the survivor encased in the Bazaar Between Time by paying 10 Lunar coins.

steps.text: Save at least 11 Lunar coins.
steps.note: They drop from monsters or are awarded at a run's end.

steps.text: Activate a @mechanic{Newt Altar} (1 coin), finish the Teleporter event, and enter the Blue Portal to the Bazaar Between Time.
Pay 10 Lunar coins at the encased survivor next to the Newt.

achievements.description: Defeat an Elite boss on Monsoon difficulty.
achievements.summary: Defeat an Elite boss while playing on Monsoon difficulty.

steps.text: Play a run on Monsoon and build damage, ideally looping first.
Fight an elite boss and defeat it.
steps.note: Artifact of Honor makes every monster elite. A Shrine of the Mountain can create an elite Teleporter boss.

achievements.description: Deal 5000 damage in one shot.
achievements.summary: Deal 5000 damage in a single hit.

steps.text: Use a heavy-damage source such as the @item{Preon Accumulator} or @item{Royal Capacitor} equipment.
steps.note: Artificer's Charged Nano-Bomb skill and an exploding @item{Genesis Loop} also reach it.

achievements.description: As Huntress, land a killing blow with every possible hit of a single glaive.
achievements.summary: Use Huntress to make every hit of one thrown glaive a killing blow.

steps.text: Select Huntress and gather a large group of weak enemies, such as Lesser Wisps.
steps.note: Strafe can weaken them first; Crowbars help.

steps.text: Throw a glaive so each of its 7 hits kills a different enemy.
steps.note: Do not let burn or bleed finish them.

achievements.description: As Huntress, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: On Monsoon, use Huntress to win the run by killing the final boss or by obliterating at the Obelisk.

steps.text: Select Huntress and start a run on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run either by defeating the final boss on @loc{Commencement} or by obliterating at the Obelisk.
steps.note: Take Sky Meadow's Teleporter while it faces the moon for Commencement. The Celestial Portal to the Obelisk appears after the stage 8 Teleporter event.

achievements.description: As Huntress, collect and carry 12 Crowbars at once.
achievements.summary: Use Huntress to hold 12 Crowbars at the same time.

steps.text: Unlock the Crowbar item first by discovering 10 unique white items.
steps.note: Crowbars can only drop once unlocked.

steps.text: Select Huntress and gather 12 Crowbars in one run.
steps.note: Use the Artifact of Command and pick Crowbar for your first 12 white items, or look for a Crowbar 3D Printer.

achievements.description: As Huntress, start and finish either Rallypoint Delta or Scorched Acres without falling below 100% health.
achievements.summary: Use Huntress to clear Rallypoint Delta or Scorched Acres from start to finish without dropping below 100% health.

steps.text: Select Huntress and reach @loc{Rallypoint Delta} or @loc{Scorched Acres}, both on stage 3.
Clear the stage without taking any health damage.
steps.note: Shields count as health; barrier does not, so Topaz Brooches help.

achievements.description: Kill 15 boss monsters in a single run.
achievements.summary: Defeat 15 boss monsters within one run.

steps.text: Defeat Teleporter bosses each stage and any other boss monsters you meet.
steps.note: Shrines of the Mountain and looping add more bosses.

achievements.description: Defeat the Teleporter boss under 15 seconds.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Teleporter boss in under 15 seconds.

steps.text: Prepare a high-damage build or burst equipment such as the Preon Accumulator or Royal Capacitor.
Start the Teleporter and kill its boss in under 15 seconds.
steps.note: A Trophy Hunter's Tricorn on the boss is a fast option.

achievements.description: Discover the hidden chamber in the Abandoned Aqueduct.
achievements.summary: Reach the secret chamber hidden inside Abandoned Aqueduct.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Abandoned Aqueduct}, one of the two stage 2 maps.
Stand on or place objects on both large Pressure Plates at the same time.
steps.note: Push a Pot onto one plate, use Engineer turrets, or play with a second player.

steps.text: Enter the hidden chamber that opens.

achievements.description: Defeat an Elite-type monster.
achievements.summary: Defeat an Elite monster.

steps.text: Defeat any monster with an elite icon on its health bar.
steps.note: Combat Shrines often spawn elites.

achievements.description: Defeat 500 elite monsters.
achievements.summary: Defeat 500 elite monsters in total.

steps.text: Keep playing; each elite you kill adds to the total.
steps.note: Artifact of Honor makes all monsters elite and speeds this up.

achievements.description: Defeat the unique guardian of Gilded Coast without any beacons deactivating.
achievements.summary: Defeat Aurelionite on Gilded Coast without any Halcyon Beacons deactivating.

steps.text: Use an @mechanic{Altar of Gold} on a stage, finish the Teleporter event, and enter the Gold Portal.
Gather enough gold to activate all 7 Halcyon Beacons.
steps.note: Activate the last beacons in quick succession.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Aurelionite} before it deactivates any beacon.

achievements.description: Defeat 3000 enemies.
achievements.summary: Defeat 3000 enemies in total.

steps.text: Keep playing runs; each enemy you kill adds to the total.
steps.note: Extra enemies come from Combat Shrines, Defiant Gouge, and Artifact of Swarms.

achievements.description: As Loader, land a Charged Gauntlet hit at 300mph or higher.
achievements.summary: Playing Loader, strike an enemy with a Charged Gauntlet while moving at 300mph or faster.

steps.text: Get speed items such as Paul's Goat Hoof, Energy Drinks and Wax Quail.
Climb to a high point, jump and use the Charged Gauntlet downward onto a monster.

achievements.description: As Loader, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Finish a Monsoon run playing Loader, either by winning the final fight or by obliterating.

steps.text: Unlock Loader by defeating the Alloy Worship Unit on Siren's Call.
Start a run as Loader on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run by beating the final boss on Commencement, or by obliterating at the Obelisk after the Celestial Portal.

achievements.description: As Loader, reach and proceed through the Celestial Portal in 25 minutes or less.
achievements.summary: Playing Loader, enter the Celestial Portal before the run timer passes 25 minutes.

steps.text: Start a run as Loader, preferably on Drizzle.
Move quickly through stages so you reach stage 8 with the clock below 25 minutes.
Enter the Celestial Portal.

achievements.description: Collect 10 Monster or Environment Logs.
achievements.summary: Collect 10 Monster or Environment Logs.

steps.text: Defeat monsters and bosses; they may drop their logs.
steps.note: Teleporter bosses have a higher drop chance.

steps.text: Buy a Radio Scanner when you see one to get that stage's Environment Log, and pick up logs in hidden realms.

achievements.description: Loop back to the first stage.
achievements.summary: Loop back to the first stage after completing stage 5.

steps.text: On stage 5, touch the spikes around the @mechanic{Primordial Teleporter} so it points at the planet.
Activate the Teleporter and finish its event to return to stage 1.
steps.note: A Lunar Portal found on stage 5 is another way to loop.

achievements.description: As Artificer, kill 15 enemies before touching the ground.
achievements.summary: Playing Artificer, get 15 kills in a single airborne stretch without landing.

steps.text: Climb to a high point and hold jump to hover.
Kill 15 enemies without landing.

achievements.description: As Artificer, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Finish a Monsoon run playing Artificer, either by winning the final fight or by obliterating.

steps.text: Unlock Artificer by buying the encased survivor for 10 Lunar coins in the Bazaar Between Time.
Start a run as Artificer on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run by beating the final boss on Commencement, or by obliterating at the Obelisk after the Celestial Portal.

achievements.description: As Artificer, fully defeat the teleporter boss in a one-second burst of damage.
achievements.summary: Playing Artificer, take the Teleporter boss from full health to zero within one second.

steps.text: Build high burst damage, for example with Crowbars, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Shaped Glass or the Preon Accumulator.
Wait for the Teleporter boss to spawn, then deal its full health in one second.

achievements.description: As Artificer, perform a multikill of 20 enemies.
achievements.summary: Playing Artificer, chain 20 kills in a single multikill.

steps.text: Gather a large group of enemies, for example with Artifact of Swarms or Artifact of Kin.
Kill 20 of them in a row, with no gap of 1 second or more between kills.

achievements.description: Kill 15 enemies simultaneously.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 enemies at once.

steps.text: Use a @item{Primordial Cube} or a pack of weak enemies to bunch 15 of them together.
steps.note: Artifact of Kin and Swarms make this easier.

steps.text: Hit the group with an area attack or equipment so they die at the same time.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade a Shrine of the Woods.
achievements.summary: Raise a Shrine of the Woods to its highest upgrade level.

steps.text: Find a @mechanic{Shrine of the Woods}, which has a tall pillar and green symbol.
steps.note: Look on Bulwark's Ambry, Siren's Call, Scorched Acres, or Distant Roost.

steps.text: Interact with it 3 times, paying gold each time.
steps.note: Save gold before you go.

achievements.description: As Mercenary, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Finish a Monsoon run playing Mercenary, either by winning the final fight or by obliterating.

steps.text: Unlock Mercenary by obliterating at the Obelisk after the Celestial Portal.
Start a run as Mercenary on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run by beating the final boss on Commencement, or by obliterating at the Obelisk after the Celestial Portal.

achievements.description: As Mercenary, complete a Prismatic Trial without falling below 100% health.
achievements.summary: Playing Mercenary, finish a Prismatic Trial with your health never dropping under full.

steps.text: Start a Prismatic Trial from Alternate Game Modes as Mercenary.
Complete the trial without taking any damage; shields count as health, barrier does not.

achievements.description: As Mercenary, don't touch the ground for 30 seconds.
achievements.summary: Playing Mercenary, stay off the ground for a full 30 seconds.

steps.text: Equip a Milky Chrysalis with a Fuel Cell, or stack Hopoo Feathers.
Jump and chain your skills to stay in the air for 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Reach +300% movespeed (includes sprinting).
achievements.summary: Reach +300% movement speed.

steps.text: Stack movement items such as @item{Paul's Goat Hoof} or @item{Energy Drink}.
steps.note: A 3D Printer or Artifact of Command speeds this up.

steps.text: Sprint until your movement speed bonus reaches +300%.
steps.note: Sprinting counts.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Combat Shrines in a single stage.
achievements.summary: Complete 3 Combat Shrines on a single stage.

steps.text: Activate a @mechanic{Combat Shrine} and kill every monster it spawns.
Do the same for 2 more Combat Shrines on the same stage.
steps.note: Maps with them: Sky Meadow, Abyssal Depths, Rallypoint Delta, Abandoned Aqueduct, Titanic Plains.

achievements.description: In 4 consecutive stages don’t leave the teleporter radius until it is fully charged.
achievements.summary: Stay inside the Teleporter radius until fully charged on 4 consecutive stages.

steps.text: On each of 4 stages in a row, stay inside the Teleporter radius until the charge hits 100%.
steps.note: The charge percentage blinks if you leave. Best done on the first 4 stages.

achievements.description: Complete the Trial of Spite.
achievements.summary: Complete the Trial of Spite in Bulwark's Ambry.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Sky Meadow} on stage 5.
Find this Artifact's 3x3 shape code on a tablet in any stage, enter it on the code array one contraption at a time, then activate the laptop beside it.
steps.note: The code tablet stands next to a code array.

steps.text: Enter the Artifact Portal to @loc{Bulwark's Ambry} and finish the event there.
steps.note: Keep moving; bombs from big monsters pile up fast.

achievements.description: Complete the Trial of Command.
achievements.summary: Complete the Trial of Command in Bulwark's Ambry.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Sky Meadow} on stage 5.
Find this Artifact's 3x3 shape code on a tablet in any stage, enter it on the code array one contraption at a time, then activate the laptop beside it.
steps.note: The code tablet stands next to a code array.

steps.text: Enter the Artifact Portal to @loc{Bulwark's Ambry} and finish the event there.

Find this Artifact's 3x3 shape code on a tablet in any stage, enter it on the code array one contraption at a time, then activate the laptop beside it.
steps.note: The code tablet stands next to a code array.

achievements.description: Complete the Trial of Soul.
achievements.summary: Complete the Trial of Soul in Bulwark's Ambry.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Sky Meadow} on stage 5.
Find this Artifact's 3x3 shape code on a tablet in any stage, enter it on the code array one contraption at a time, then activate the laptop beside it.
steps.note: The code tablet stands next to a code array.

steps.text: Enter the Artifact Portal to @loc{Bulwark's Ambry} and finish the event there.
steps.note: Area-damage items, for example Will-o'-the-wisp, neutralise the wisps.

achievements.description: Duplicate the same item 7 times in a row with a 3D Printer.
achievements.summary: Print the same item 7 times consecutively at a 3D Printer.

steps.text: Find a 3D Printer and pick an item you own many copies of.
Print that item again and again until you have done it 7 times without a break at that printer.
steps.note: Using a different printer resets your streak.

achievements.description: Complete the first Teleporter event 5 times.
achievements.summary: Finish stage 1's Teleporter event in 5 separate runs.

steps.text: Complete stage 1's Teleporter event in a run.
Quit and start another run. Repeat until you have done it 5 times.
steps.note: Drizzle is easiest.

achievements.description: Repair the broken robot with an Escape Pod's Fuel Array.
achievements.summary: Repair the broken robot on Abyssal Depths with the Fuel Array from your Escape Pod.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Fuel Array} from your starting Escape Pod. Do not use MUL-T or Acrid.
steps.note: It explodes if your health goes below 50% while carried.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Abyssal Depths} on stage 4 with it.
steps.note: The Blue Portal on stage 3 can be used to choose this stage.

steps.text: Climb to the second-highest platform in the middle and interact with the broken robot.

achievements.description: Stay alive for 30 consecutive minutes.
achievements.summary: Stay alive for 30 consecutive minutes.

steps.text: Complete the Teleporter event on stage 1 but do not leave the stage.
Wait until the timer reaches 30 minutes without dying.
steps.note: Monsters stop spawning once the Teleporter event is done.

achievements.description: Kill 20 Hermit Crabs by chasing them off the edge of the map.
achievements.summary: Chase 20 Hermit Crabs off the edge of the map so they die.

steps.text: Loop at least once and reach @loc{Titanic Plains}.
Run at Hermit Crabs so they flee and fall off the edge. Repeat for 20 crabs.
steps.note: Do not take items or drones that kill them before they fall.

achievements.description: As MUL-T, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Finish a Monsoon run playing MUL-T, either by winning the final fight or by obliterating.

steps.text: Unlock MUL-T by finishing the first Teleporter event five times.
Start a run as MUL-T on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run by beating the final boss on Commencement, or by obliterating at the Obelisk after the Celestial Portal.

achievements.description: As MUL-T, defeat two Beetle Queens without leaving the teleporter zone.
achievements.summary: Playing MUL-T, kill 2 Beetle Queens while staying inside the Teleporter's radius.

steps.text: Start a run as MUL-T with Artifact of Swarms enabled, or use a Shrine of the Mountain before the Teleporter.
Stay inside the Teleporter radius and defeat two Beetle Queens.

achievements.description: As MUL-T, land the killing blow on an Imp Overlord with the Preon Accumulator.
achievements.summary: Playing MUL-T, deal the final damage to an Imp Overlord using the Preon Accumulator.

steps.text: Rallypoint Delta's timed chest holds the Preon Accumulator if you open it fast enough; Artifact of Command lets you pick it directly.
Find an Imp Overlord and bring it to low health.
Use the Preon Accumulator so it lands the killing blow.

achievements.description: Repair 30 drones or turrets.
achievements.summary: Repair 30 drones or turrets in total.

steps.text: Pay to repair every broken drone and turret you find.
steps.note: Counts across runs; the Equipment Drone is free if you have equipment.

achievements.description: Collect $30,480 total gold.
achievements.summary: Collect $30,480 total gold across all runs.

steps.text: Keep playing; gold from kills and chests adds to the total.
steps.note: Later stages give more gold, and Ghor's Tome helps.

achievements.description: As REX, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Finish a Monsoon run playing REX, either by winning the final fight or by obliterating.

steps.text: Unlock REX by repairing the deactivated REX on Abyssal Depths with a Fuel Array.
Start a run as REX on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run by beating the final boss on Commencement, or by obliterating at the Obelisk after the Celestial Portal.

achievements.description: As REX, kill a Clay Dunestrider on Abandoned Aqueduct by throwing it into a pit.
achievements.summary: Playing REX, push a Clay Dunestrider into a pit on Abandoned Aqueduct so it dies there.

steps.text: Reach Abandoned Aqueduct and find a Clay Dunestrider.
Lure it next to one of the two pits.
Push it in with DIRECTIVE: Disperse.

achievements.description: As REX, complete an entire teleporter event while under 50% health.
achievements.summary: Playing REX, stay below half health from the start of a Teleporter event to its end.

steps.text: Lower your health below 50%, for example with Seed Barrage or a Shrine of Blood.
Start the Teleporter event and keep health below 50% until it finishes.

achievements.description: Discover and enter three unique portals.
achievements.summary: Discover and enter three different portals.

steps.text: Activate a @mechanic{Newt Altar}, finish the Teleporter event, and enter the Blue Portal.
In the Bazaar, drop down into the cave and enter the Null Portal.
Enter a third portal: a Gold Portal after using an Altar of Gold, or the Celestial Portal after looping.

achievements.description: As Bandit, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: On Monsoon, use Bandit to win the run by killing the final boss or by obliterating at the Obelisk.

steps.text: Select Bandit and start a run on Monsoon difficulty.
Finish the run either by defeating the final boss on @loc{Commencement} or by obliterating at the Obelisk.
steps.note: Take Sky Meadow's Teleporter while it faces the moon for Commencement. The Celestial Portal to the Obelisk appears after the stage 8 Teleporter event.

achievements.description: As Bandit, successfully use 'Lights Out' to reset your cooldowns 15 times in a row.
achievements.summary: Use Bandit to get 15 kills in a row with Lights Out, each one resetting your cooldowns.

steps.text: Select Bandit and weaken a monster, then use @mechanic{Lights Out} so it lands the kill.
steps.note: A kill with Lights Out resets all cooldowns, including its own.

steps.text: Repeat with 15 kills in a row, each ending with Lights Out.
steps.note: Do not kill a monster any other way in between.

achievements.description: As Bandit, kill the final boss with 'Lights Out'.
achievements.summary: Use Bandit to land the final boss's killing blow with Lights Out.

steps.text: Select Bandit, reach the final boss and weaken it with normal attacks.
steps.note: Avoid on-hit items and drones so nothing else lands the kill.

steps.text: Land the killing blow with @mechanic{Lights Out}.
steps.note: Slayer makes Lights Out hit harder on low-health bosses.

achievements.description: As Bandit, kill a monster with 20 stacks of Hemorrhage.
achievements.summary: Use Bandit to kill a monster that has 20 stacks of Hemorrhage.

steps.text: Select Bandit and use the Serrated Dagger secondary on a tough monster, such as an elite or boss.
steps.note: Hemorrhage applies when the Serrated Dagger crits.

steps.text: Keep critting until the monster has 20 stacks of Hemorrhage, then kill it.
steps.note: Hemorrhage lasts 15 seconds, so apply stacks regularly.

achievements.description: As Captain, kill the final boss using a Supply Beacon
achievements.summary: Playing Captain, have a Supply Beacon deliver the killing blow to the final boss.

steps.text: Reach the final boss on Commencement.
In its last stage, call a Supply Beacon so it lands on the boss and finishes it.

achievements.description: As Loader, kill three other Loaders in the Bulwark's Ambry.
achievements.summary: Playing Loader, destroy 3 other Loaders inside Bulwark's Ambry.

steps.text: Reach stage 5 as Loader and enter the Artifact Portal to Bulwark's Ambry.
Use the Artifact of Vengeance code so Loader doppelgangers invade.
Kill three of the Loaders.

achievements.description: As Mercenary, use 20 abilities in 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Playing Mercenary, trigger 20 skills inside a 10-second window.

steps.text: Get Backup Magazine or Hardlight Afterburner, or kill an elite with Brainstalks.
Spam all skills until 20 uses land within 10 seconds.

achievements.description: As MUL-T, clear the Void Fields on Stage 7 or later.
achievements.summary: Playing MUL-T, finish the Void Fields in a run that has already reached stage 7 or beyond.

steps.text: Loop the game at least once so the stage counter reaches 7.
Reach the Bazaar Between Time through a Blue Portal and drop down to the cave below it to find the Null Portal.
Enter the Void Fields and complete all 9 cell events.

achievements.description: As REX, heal for 1000 health at once.
achievements.summary: Playing REX, recover 1000 health in a single heal.

steps.text: Build more than 1,000 maximum health with Infusion and Bison Steak.
Drop to low health with REX's skills.
Use Foreign Fruit or Lepton Daisy, or a Medkit, to heal 1,000 health in one go.

achievements.description: Escape the Planetarium or complete wave 50 in Simulacrum.
achievements.summary: Beat the Planetarium to escape it, or clear wave 50 of Simulacrum.

steps.text: Obtain a Void Portal: finish every cell of the Void Fields, pick it from the Lunar Seer in the Bazaar Between Time, or find one randomly after a Teleporter event.
Enter the Void Portal and charge 4 Deep Void Signals in the Void Locus to open the way to the Planetarium.
Defeat the boss of the Planetarium.
steps.note: Clearing wave 50 of Simulacrum works too, as does petting the glass frog 10 times at Commencement after Mithrix falls.

achievements.description: As Railgunner, deal 1,000,000 damage in one shot.
achievements.summary: Playing Railgunner, land one shot that does 1,000,000 damage.

steps.text: Collect as many @item{Crowbar} and @item{Lens-Maker's Glasses} as you can; if you cannot gather enough, add the Lunar item @item{Shaped Glass}.
Activate Supercharge, fire M99 Sniper at a monster's Weak Point, using the @item{Ocular HUD} equipment first if you own one.

achievements.description: As Railgunner, fire 30 consecutive sniper shots without missing a Weak Point.
achievements.summary: Playing Railgunner, hit a Weak Point with 30 sniper shots in a row.

steps.text: Use the M99 Sniper Secondary on slow, predictable monsters such as @enemy{Wisp}, @enemy{Beetle} and @enemy{Stone Golem}.
Line the reticle up with the red Weak Point box before every shot.
steps.note: Shots do not have to kill. A side hit is fine so long as a Weak Point is struck.

achievements.description: As Railgunner, get 3 kills with a single Supercharge shot while airborne.
achievements.summary: Playing Railgunner, kill three enemies with one airborne Supercharge shot.

steps.text: Get off the ground with Concussion Device, @item{Hopoo Feather} or by jumping off a cliff.
Line up three weakened enemies and fire Supercharge before you land.
steps.note: @enemy{Beetle} and @enemy{Lemurian} walk in straight lines and are easy to line up.

achievements.description: As Railgunner, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Playing Railgunner, win a run on Monsoon or obliterate yourself there.

steps.text: Select Railgunner and set the difficulty to Monsoon.
Beat the final boss, or obliterate yourself at the Obelisk, in one run.

achievements.description: As 「V??oid Fiend』, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Playing Void Fiend, win a run on Monsoon or obliterate yourself there.

steps.text: Select Void Fiend and set the difficulty to Monsoon.
Beat the final boss, or obliterate yourself at the Obelisk, in one run.

achievements.description: Journey to Prime Meridian and defeat the False Son.
achievements.summary: Go to Prime Meridian and kill the False Son.

steps.text: Start the Path of the Colossus through a green portal from a Halcyon Shrine on stage 1, 2 or 3.
Travel to @loc{Prime Meridian} and kill the False Son boss.
steps.note: Any difficulty and survivor work. Carrying a Halcyon Seed also unlocks Purified Freedom.

achievements.description: Purify the Heart of the False Son using the Halcyon Seed.
achievements.summary: Cleanse the False Son's Heart during the boss fight by using the Halcyon Seed.

steps.text: Defeat Aurelionite on @loc{Gilded Coast} to get the @item{Halcyon Seed}.
Start the Path of the Colossus and reach the False Son at the end of @loc{Prime Meridian}.
Defeat the False Son while you carry the Halcyon Seed.
steps.note: The seed is taken during the fight and Aurelionite appears. Only the False Son must be defeated.

achievements.description: Complete the Wok's recipe on Reformed Altar.
achievements.summary: Complete the Wok's recipe on Reformed Altar to unlock CHEF.

steps.text: Start the Path of the Colossus through a green portal and reach @loc{Reformed Altar}.
Put a @item{Cautious Slug}, a @item{Bison Steak} and an @item{Infusion} into the Wok.
steps.note: One of each is enough, and they can be added across different runs.

achievements.description: As CHEF, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Playing CHEF, win a run on Monsoon or obliterate yourself there.

steps.text: Select CHEF and set the difficulty to Monsoon.
Beat the final boss, or obliterate yourself at the Obelisk, in one run.

achievements.description: As CHEF complete 10 recipes by searing an oiled bison with Sear.
achievements.summary: Playing CHEF, finish 10 recipes by oil-glazing a bison and then using Sear on it.

steps.text: Use Glaze on a @enemy{Bighorn Bison} to oil it up.
steps.note: Bison appear on @loc{Rallypoint Delta} and @loc{Shattered Abodes}.

steps.text: Use Sear on the oiled bison until you have done this 10 times.

achievements.description: As CHEF hit five airborne enemies with one instance of Roll.
achievements.summary: Playing CHEF, strike five enemies in midair with a single Roll.

steps.text: Group flying enemies such as @enemy{Lesser Wisp} together, or lift them with a @item{Primordial Cube}.
Jump up near them, use Roll, and hit five enemies that are off the ground.
steps.note: Roll lasts 2.5 seconds, or 4 seconds at full charge. You only have to hit them, not kill them.

achievements.displayName: CHEF: It’s Getting Hot In Here!
achievements.description: As CHEF apply 20 stacks of Burn at once to the final boss.
achievements.summary: Playing CHEF, have 20 Burn stacks on the final boss at the same moment.

steps.text: Reach the final boss on Commencement as CHEF.
Keep applying Burn until the boss has 20 stacks at once.

achievements.description: As False Son, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Playing False Son, win a run on Monsoon or obliterate yourself there.

steps.text: Select False Son and set the difficulty to Monsoon.
Beat the final boss, or obliterate yourself at the Obelisk, in one run.

achievements.description: As False Son, kill 15 enemies with one activation of Laser of the Father.
achievements.summary: Playing False Son, defeat 15 enemies with a single Laser of the Father.

steps.text: Group weakened enemies, such as @enemy{Lesser Wisp}, in front of you.
Fully charge Laser of the Father, fire it, and use Step of the Brothers to keep your distance.
steps.note: Higher health from @item{Infusion} lengthens the laser.

achievements.description: As False Son, have Aurelionite kill the final boss while the final boss is inflicted with at least one Lunar Ruin.
achievements.summary: Playing False Son, let Aurelionite land the last hit on the final boss while it carries a Lunar Ruin.

steps.text: Get Aurelionite fighting for you and reach the final boss on Commencement.
Apply Lunar Ruin to the final boss, then let Aurelionite land the killing blow.

achievements.description: As False Son, gain up to 40 Lunar Spikes through Growth.
achievements.summary: Playing False Son, reach 40 Lunar Spikes gained from Growth.

steps.text: Raise your maximum health with @item{Bison Steak}, @item{Infusion} and stat items such as Growth Nectar.
steps.note: Spikes from Backup Magazines do not count.

steps.text: Keep stacking Growth until you have 44 Lunar Spikes in total.

achievements.description: As Seeker, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
achievements.summary: Playing Seeker, win a run on Monsoon or obliterate yourself there.

steps.text: Select Seeker and set the difficulty to Monsoon.
Beat the final boss, or obliterate yourself at the Obelisk, in one run.

achievements.description: As Seeker, meditate 20 times without missing an input in a single run.
achievements.summary: Playing Seeker, complete 20 meditations in one run without a single wrong input.

steps.text: Meditate with the movement keys, entering each input correctly, 20 times in one run.
steps.note: You do not have to gather Tranquility stacks, and the meditations do not need to be consecutive.

steps.text: Do it on Easy by hiding in a corner on stage 1, or during the Teleporter event.

achievements.description: Deal 500,000% damage with one use of Sojourn's explosion
achievements.summary: Playing Seeker, make one Sojourn explosion deal 500,000% damage.

steps.text: Make a single use of Sojourn's explosion deal 500,000% damage.

achievements.description: As Seeker, hit three or more airborne enemies with a single use of the exploding third hit of Spirit Punch.
achievements.summary: Playing Seeker, damage three or more airborne enemies with one explosive third Spirit Punch hit.

steps.text: Fire the first two Spirit Punch hits at the ground.
Fire the third, exploding hit at a group of flying enemies such as @enemy{Wisp}.
steps.note: The explosion only has to damage them. Avoid attack speed so the timing is easier.

achievements.description: As Acrid, complete the Event on Prime Meridian.
achievements.summary: Finish the Prime Meridian event while playing Acrid.

steps.text: Unlock Acrid by stabilizing the Cell in the Void Fields.
Start a run as Acrid and enter the Path of the Colossus through a green portal from a Halcyon Shrine, or choose it with a Lunar Seer in the Bazaar Between Time.
Clear Reformed Altar and Treeborn Colony.
On Prime Meridian, finish the event by defeating the False Son at the top.

achievements.description: As Artificer, complete the Event on Prime Meridian.
achievements.summary: Finish the Prime Meridian event while playing Artificer.

steps.text: Unlock Artificer by buying the encased survivor for 10 Lunar coins in the Bazaar Between Time.
Start a run as Artificer and enter the Path of the Colossus through a green portal from a Halcyon Shrine, or choose it with a Lunar Seer in the Bazaar Between Time.
Clear Reformed Altar and Treeborn Colony.
On Prime Meridian, finish the event by defeating the False Son at the top.

achievements.description: As Bandit, complete the Event on Prime Meridian.
achievements.summary: Use Bandit to finish the Prime Meridian Event.

steps.text: Select Bandit and reach @loc{Prime Meridian} through the Path of the Colossus.
steps.note: Green portals from Halcyon Shrines on stages 1-3 or the Gilded Coast, or Lunar Seers, start the Path.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{False Son} to complete the event.

achievements.description: As Captain, complete the Event on Prime Meridian.
achievements.summary: Finish the Prime Meridian event while playing Captain.

steps.text: Unlock Captain by beating the game.
Start a run as Captain and enter the Path of the Colossus through a green portal from a Halcyon Shrine, or choose it with a Lunar Seer in the Bazaar Between Time.
Clear Reformed Altar and Treeborn Colony.
On Prime Meridian, finish the event by defeating the False Son at the top.

achievements.description: As Commando, complete the Event on Prime Meridian.
achievements.summary: Use Commando to finish the Prime Meridian Event.

steps.text: Select Commando and reach @loc{Prime Meridian} through the Path of the Colossus.
steps.note: Green portals from Halcyon Shrines on stages 1-3 or the Gilded Coast, or Lunar Seers, start the Path.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{False Son} to complete the event.

achievements.description: As Engineer, complete the Event on Prime Meridian.
achievements.summary: Use Engineer to finish the Prime Meridian Event.

steps.text: Select Engineer and reach @loc{Prime Meridian} through the Path of the Colossus.
steps.note: Green portals from Halcyon Shrines on stages 1-3 or the Gilded Coast, or Lunar Seers, start the Path.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{False Son} to complete the event.

achievements.description: As Huntress, complete the Event on Prime Meridian.
achievements.summary: Use Huntress to finish the Prime Meridian Event.

steps.text: Select Huntress and reach @loc{Prime Meridian} through the Path of the Colossus.
steps.note: Green portals from Halcyon Shrines on stages 1-3 or the Gilded Coast, or Lunar Seers, start the Path.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{False Son} to complete the event.

achievements.description: As Loader, complete the Event on Prime Meridian.
achievements.summary: Finish the Prime Meridian event while playing Loader.

steps.text: Unlock Loader by defeating the Alloy Worship Unit on Siren's Call.

steps.text: In @loc{Conduit Canyon}, collect 6 Sentry Keys from Collective elite monsters and finish the Teleporter.

achievements.summary: Playing Drifter, hold 20 temporary items simultaneously.

steps.text: Make temporary items with Salvage, Junk Drones, Temporary Item Distributors or @item{Substandard Duplicator}.
Drop Salvage items on the ground without picking them up, then pick up 20 together.
steps.note: Dropped items do not despawn.

achievements.summary: Playing Drifter, take what is in the abandoned backpack inside the Solutional Haunt vault.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Solutional Haunt} as Drifter and defeat its boss.
Open the vault with a @item{Prison Matrix} and take the backpack's contents.

achievements.description: As Drifter defeat a boss from the challenge of the Mountain using a Shrine of the Mountain.
achievements.summary: Playing Drifter, kill a teleporter boss with a thrown Shrine of the Mountain.

steps.text: Activate a @mechanic{Shrine of the Mountain}, then pick it up with Repossess and carry it to the Teleporter.
Throw it at a boss with Repossess until it dies.
steps.note: Do not bash the shrine while holding it, or it breaks. Area damage such as @item{Gasoline} can kill the boss without you.

achievements.description: As Operator recruit 5 different drones.
achievements.summary: Playing Operator, buy five different kinds of drones.

steps.text: Buy drones from Drone Shops, skipping DOC and CROSSHAIRS which you start with.
Recruit 5 different drones.
steps.note: Three copies of one drone count once. Triple Drone Shops and later stages offer higher-tier drones.

achievements.description: As Operator defeat the teleporter boss on Conduit Canyon without touching the ground.
achievements.summary: Playing Operator, kill the Teleporter boss on Conduit Canyon while never touching the ground.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Conduit Canyon} as Operator through an Encrypted Portal from a stage 3 environment.
Fight the Teleporter boss while staying off the ground the whole time.

achievements.description: As Operator keep an Elder Lemurian airborne for 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Playing Operator, hold an Elder Lemurian in the air for 10 seconds.

steps.text: Keep an @enemy{Elder Lemurian} in the air for 10 seconds.

achievements.description: As Operator kill 4 different types of monsters with a single ricochet.
achievements.summary: Playing Operator, kill four different monster types with one ricochet.

steps.text: Raise damage with @item{Crowbar} and @item{Delicate Watch}, and fully charge the shot.
Fire at a crowd of at least four different monster types so the ricochet kills one of each.
steps.note: Avoid stages with few monster types. Artifact of Dissonance adds variety.

steps.note: An Encrypted Portal appears on its own or from an Access Node.

steps.text: Defeat the Solus Wing boss and open its two side rooms.
Find a Solus Coffer in each side room to get two @item{Prison Matrix} items, then use one on the vault and one on the survivor.

steps.text: Go beyond the veil and defeat the @enemy{Echo of Providence} in its four-phase fight.

achievements.summary: Finish a run with Loader while you carry ten Hexes.

steps.text: Unlock Loader by defeating the Alloy Worship Unit on Siren's Call.

Activate a Shrine of Descent beside a Teleporter (it appears only before any major catastrophe and while your team holds enough N'tormat Pages), then enter Soulbound Threshold. When the Anima Harvester's second phase appears, each player receives 3 random Hexes.
Keep every Hex: do not cleanse them at a Hallowed Shrine.
Hold 10 Hexes when the run ends.

achievements.description: As Acrid, complete Soulbound Threshold before the 4th Teleporter event.
achievements.summary: Playing Acrid, finish Soulbound Threshold while fewer than four Teleporter events have been completed.

steps.text: Unlock Acrid by stabilizing the Cell in the Void Fields.
Start a run as Acrid and activate a Shrine of Descent beside a Teleporter (it appears only before any major catastrophe and while your team holds enough N'tormat Pages).
Charge the Teleporter fully, survive the overcharge and enter the Ritual Portal.
Begin the ritual at the Altar of N'kuhana and beat the four challenges.
Defeat both phases of the Anima Harvester before a fourth Teleporter has been charged.

achievements.description: As Captain, defeat what lies beyond the door of Soulbound Threshold.
achievements.summary: Playing Captain, defeat the enemy waiting past the Soulbound Threshold door.

steps.text: Unlock Captain by beating the game.

Activate a Shrine of Descent beside a Teleporter (it appears only before any major catastrophe and while your team holds enough N'tormat Pages), charge the Teleporter and enter the Ritual Portal to reach Soulbound Threshold.
Complete the ritual by defeating the Anima Harvester.
Cast Reincarnation in the sacrifice zone near the center pedestal so the door opens, then go beyond the Veil of Memory.
Defeat the Echo of Providence in Terminal Lucidity.

achievements.description: As Railgunner, complete a run while holding 10 Hexes.
achievements.summary: Playing Railgunner, finish a run with 10 Hexes in your possession.

guide.context: Hexes come from Hallowed Concepts, so you need that expansion as well.

steps.text: Reach the second phase of the @enemy{Anima Harvester} in Soulbound Threshold, which gives every player 3 random Hexes.
A Hallowed Shrine removes Hexes, so do not use one; keep the Hexes you collect and finish the run.

achievements.description: As Artificer, reach the final boss on the moon without activating a pillar.
achievements.summary: Playing Artificer, arrive at the moon's final boss with no pillar having been activated.

steps.text: Reach the moon (Commencement) as Artificer.
Go to the final boss without activating any pillar.

achievements.description: As Commando, defeat the final boss after earning 8 karma.
achievements.summary: Use Commando to kill the final boss after reaching 8 karma.

steps.text: Select Commando and raise your karma to 8.
steps.note: Defeating the Anima Harvester's second phase in Soulbound Threshold raises karma by 1.

steps.text: Defeat the final boss on @loc{Commencement}.

achievements.description: As Engineer, repair an Equipment Drone with an Escape Pod's Fuel Array.
achievements.summary: Use Engineer to repair an Equipment Drone with the Fuel Array from an Escape Pod.

steps.text: Select Engineer and take the Fuel Array from your Escape Pod at the start of the run.
Find a broken @item{Equipment Drone} and repair it while the Fuel Array is your equipment.
steps.note: The Fuel Array explodes and kills you if your health falls below 50% while it is equipped.

achievements.description: As Huntress, obtain an Artifact from the Bulwark's Ambry in 25 minutes or less.
achievements.summary: Use Huntress to claim an Artifact in Bulwark's Ambry within 25 minutes.

steps.text: Select Huntress and reach @loc{Sky Meadow} fast, then enter a known Artifact code at the Compound Generator.
Take the Artifact Portal into @loc{Bulwark's Ambry} and finish the event within 25 minutes.

achievements.description: As REX, beat the game with at least 5 different Lunar items.
achievements.summary: Playing REX, win the game while holding five or more distinct Lunar items.

steps.text: Pick up 5 different Lunar items; Lunar Pods and the Bazaar Between Time both supply them.
Beat the game as REX while holding them.

achievements.description: As Acrid, beat the game after sequencing your items at least once.
achievements.summary: Playing Acrid, win the game in a run where you have sequenced your items at least one time.

steps.text: Sequence your items at least once during the run.
Beat the game as Acrid.
